prediction.inputs: Pinned CT10/DSSV08/DSS14 with strict Q0 samples and explicitly labeled reference extrapolation at unsupported Fourier scales; verify build hashes and require the retained bridge source to match the current project bridge before use.
prediction.loop: Julia owns prepared predictions, fixed-parameter values, comparisons and residual arithmetic. Python/Snakemake schedules whole jobs and renders completed outputs. No provider/native/Python/language-model callback inside a parameter evaluation.

numerical_policy.acceptance: At least three frozen joint native/matching/radial levels are required. Every selected point's UU, signed Collins numerator and final amplitude must meet the unchanged1e-4 adjacent-level target. Compare the final24-to32 radial extension at the same target; retain all coarse values and failures. Exhausting the declared ladder is FAIL.
numerical_policy.independent_reference: At the final fixed native rows, use the existing ObservableReference separate scalar charge/CSS/Bessel assembly to compare every requested point at1e-4. This shares native/source rows and initial-function definitions; it is not an independent evolution solution. Parent Mellin/native/input checks remain separate.
numerical_policy.source_convention_check: Use256-bit independent two-angle Fourier projection of explicitly synthetic positive counts under the primary Eq1 yield definition, testing both signs and the actual selected y values. Use P=1/2, R=+/-1/8 and nonzero Sivers coefficient1/16, uniform mathematical phi_h/phi_S integration over[0,2pi]^2 and normalization1/(2pi^2). The source-definition fixture is separate from the real pinned-input calculation and experimental acceptance. Retain wrong-phase, omitted/repeated-DNN and factor2 counterfactuals; do not infer convention from measured signs.
numerical_policy.fixed_value_controls: Check algebra against the context's signed numerator/positive denominator, global transversity-Collins sign invariance and exact charge reuse. No asymmetry clamp or absolute-value numerator.
numerical_policy.derivative_scope: The current job reports fixed-parameter predictions only. It creates no new production-gradient/performance/coverage certificate; inherited all-parameter derivative validation remains separate.

observations_and_products.errors: Preserve statistical, experimental-systematic and model-systematic source components separately. Construct no covariance, combined error, normalization nuisance, chi2, pulls or likelihood.
observations_and_products.residual: An optional unweighted observed-minus-predicted difference is a diagnostic scalar, not a statistical test or fit.
observations_and_products.artifacts: Source-bound request, complete Julia diagnostic report with raw refinement/reference operands, and a clearly labeled fixed-parameter theory/data comparison. Source data and generated outputs remain out of Git.
observations_and_products.numerical_cache: No serialized production numerical cache or fit admission. Current inputs/source/request/output hashes and source-derived request reconstruction must be checked on cached workflow products; rehashing altered provenance does not approve it.
